method: git ls-files grouped by top-level path segment; named modules resolved against source at source_revision; importer counts include absolute and intra-package relative imports (AST); test importers are files under tests/.

native.note: Rust crates (native toolchain). Reference for NATIVE-TOOLCHAIN; the Python package does not import it in this baseline.

orchestra.note: Engineering workflow orchestration (main-native keeps it; OPERATING_MODEL notes main removed it). Not runtime.

planning.note: Plan, ledger and baseline documents; not importable runtime code.

research_tools.note: Evidence builders, audits and benchmarks; not product code. Kept as reference and evidence producers.

named_modules.rationale: Gym environment runtime is the semantic reference until NATIVE-ENVIRONMENT and BATCHED-ENVIRONMENT pass the single/batch parity oracle; then the Python runtime is replaced. 15 production importers.
EpisodeRuntimeMixin is mixed into env.py only (one production importer). Fold into the environment runtime during NATIVE-ENVIRONMENT; no independent consumer.
Shared bundle ABI (13 top-level definitions) consumed by bundles.py and env.py; SHARED-DATA-ABI extends it rather than replacing it.

Second bundle module next to shared_bundle.py (build_env_bundle is imported by eight research and production modules). Consolidate the bundle surface into one ABI module after caller inventory; keep the build_env_bundle name as a compatibility alias until then.
Environment worker process; seven importers, mostly research benchmarks. Keep until RESOURCE-RUNTIME defines the worker contract.
Causal HTF alignment (shift(1) default, availability_times path) and join_symbols. join_symbols same-stamp join is a review item (JOIN-SAME-STAMP-REVIEW).
purged_walk_forward is non-overlapping, purge includes label horizon, embargo precedes each test fold (source-verified). Silent zero-fold output for short series (WF-SILENT-EMPTY).
Tick/quote loader (1389 lines, 43 production importers). Reference for DATA-INGESTION; not replaced in this package.
Feature matrix builder and cache identity. Prev-day level defect originates in features/technical/structure.py, not in this package.
Pure daily-floor and capacity arithmetic; breach floor at or below limit is conservative per DECISIONS 2026-11-26. Covered by the oracle and mutation set.
Risk budget, contracts, sizing and guardrails; in the mutation-critical set (budget.py, contracts.py). Do not weaken hard floors.
Versioned action coordinate contract (overlay-action-v2, discrete-trading-v1). In the mutation-critical set.
PPO/SAC agent adapter (1047 lines). Correctness audit deferred to LEARNER-CONTRACT tests; no defect recorded here.
Hybrid learner (1398 lines, 4 production importers). Large; consolidation candidate only after LEARNER-CONTRACT fixtures exist.
Training callbacks (1434 lines). Consumed by training/setup and seed_runtime; no defect recorded here.
Seed runtime (1427 lines, 1 production importer). Seed identity is part of provenance; keep.
Variant catalog resolution (config/variant_catalog.yaml). Foundation the plan says to extend rather than duplicate.
Experiment run orchestration (6116 lines, 99 top-level definitions). Consolidation candidate under EXECUTION-DAG and EXPERIMENT-CATALOG after caller inventory; no removal.
Single production importer (experiments/runs/orchestration.py import). Consolidate into experiments/runs with the rest of the orchestration surface.
Artifact identity. json default=str coerces unknown types, so distinct semantic inputs can collide (ARTIFACT-ID-COERCION).
Manifest schema helpers (one top-level definition); small and used by artifacts/promotion.py and artifacts/__init__.py.
Artifact layout (401 lines, 11 production importers).
Atomic writers used by 62 production modules. Temp files are created 0600 when no mode is given (ATOMIC-NEW-FILE-MODE); no parent-directory fsync.
Persistent worker dispatch (499 lines). RESOURCE-RUNTIME extends it; not replaced by a competing scheduler.

remove_after_proof_candidates.reason: No production caller; only tests/unit/trading/test_semantic_oracle_costs.py exercises it. Remove after that test is migrated or retired and the caller inventory stays empty.
Overlapping pre-fix stepper (F5). No production caller; callers are tests/unit/market_data/test_walkforward*.py only. Remove after the compatibility tests are retired.

name_resolution_notes: simulation/environment/episode_runtime.py and shared_bundle.py have no production importer by absolute import; they are imported by env.py and bundles.py through relative imports.
trading/risk is a package (7 modules plus __init__.py and README.md); the plan path trading/risk/ is kept as the package-level entry.
features/pipeline and experiments/{variants,runs,orchestration} are packages; entries are package-level.
